summary: Tested the new PASSWORD RESET feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py (12 pytest cases) covering owner->room-admin reset, admin->member reset, cross-room isolation, role authorization (403), validation (422), unknown ids (404) and unauthenticated access — 12/12 passed. Frontend: full E2E Playwright flow on the real preview URL (Owner resets Bob's password via key-icon modal -> Bob logs in with new password -> Bob resets Alice via member row modal -> Alice logs in with new password). All passed. All passwords restored to originals (Bob@12345 / Alice@12345 / Charlie@123) and verified by login (200).
critical_code_review_comments: Owner reset-admin button disabled state (disabled={!r.admin}) could NOT be verified in the UI because every room currently has an admin — code path looks correct but is unexercised.

Ingress returns access-control-allow-origin: * together with access-control-allow-credentials: true (pre-existing, infra-level; app uses Bearer tokens in localStorage, not cookies). Not caused by this feature but worth noting for production hardening.

Password reset endpoints do not invalidate the target user's existing sessions/JWTs; a compromised session remains valid after an admin resets the password. Consider bumping a token version / clearing sessions on reset.
No audit trail is written for password resets (who reset whose password, when). Recommended for a multi-tenant admin feature.
seed_data_creation: Temporary second room + admin (TEST_admin_*@example.com) created and deleted within the cross-room authorization test. No persistent seed data left behind.
test_credentials: Owner xpertcctv.delhi@gmail.com/love@2001, Admin bob.ops@example.com/Bob@12345, User alice.ops/Alice@12345 — all verified working after test cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: the working preview URL is https://realtime-voice-hub-6.preview.emergentagent.com (from /app/frontend/.env). The URL quoted in the review request (audio-conf-1...) serves an Emergent 'Preview Unavailable' page and must not be used. Backend has brute-force lockout after 5 failed logins per identifier — keep intentional wrong-password attempts under 5 and always follow with a successful login (which clears the counter). Regression suite for this feature: /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py (run with `pytest tests/test_password_reset.py -p xdist -n 0` from /app/backend). Bob room id feb97dad-08c7-4de0-b28d-fabb4a85719d, Alice user id 844333b5-e21c-496a-a3b3-d8906f60aeaf.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in the password reset feature. The only blocker encountered was an incorrect preview hostname in the review request, resolved by reading REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
